status: Provisional canonical model, not measured monument glyphs; no cryptanalytic result.
scope: An explicitly modeled uppercase Latin skeleton. Geometry identifies the selected glyphs, not letter meaning or an encryption mechanism.

coordinates.line_semantics: Undirected straight segment with exact endpoints; intersections do not subdivide it.
coordinates.arc_semantics: For 0<=t<=1, x=cx+rx*cos((start_degrees+t*sweep_degrees)*pi/180), y=cy+ry*sin(...). The whole declared arc is one curved primitive. A full 360-degree arc is closed.
coordinates.precision: Coordinates and degree values are exact declarations. Trigonometric evaluation is only needed to render; vectorization does not round them.

choices.G: one near-closed arc and inward horizontal bar; no vertical spur
choices.Q: closed oval with straight lower-right tail
choices.U: two upper vertical legs and one lower semicircle

vectorization.feature_order_rule: ASCII lexicographic order of the frozen primitive IDs; explicit feature_order below is authoritative.
vectorization.entry: Number of occurrences of that exact geometric primitive in the glyph. All current entries are 0 or 1.
vectorization.unknown_primitives: Reject; do not append silently. A changed geometry or dictionary needs a new model version.
vectorization.invertibility: Within this frozen dictionary, vectors recover the exact unordered primitive multiset. They do not preserve writing order or pen direction.
vectorization.glyph_array_note: glyphs below are sparse named-component arrays, not dense fixed-length vectors. vectors below are the dense fixed-length arrays.
vectorization.incidence_note: This is a component-incidence vector, not a graph vertex-edge incidence matrix. Geometric touching/crossing can be derived separately.

tree_rule: At each node choose the lowest-index feature whose values differ among remaining glyphs; branch by its count. A leaf returns its unique glyph. This is deterministic representation lookup, not cipher inference.

ordinary_sum.interpretation: Only counts primitives. In this model every letter shares its sum with at least one other letter.

binary_weighted_sum.formula: N = sum(v[i] * 2^i), with zero-based i in the frozen feature_order.
binary_weighted_sum.exact_decode: Use arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic. For i=0..34, v[i]=(N >> i) & 1. In JavaScript, N must be BigInt: Number((BigInt(decimalString) >> BigInt(i)) & 1n). Never apply Number bitwise operators, which truncate to 32 bits. Require 0 <= N < 2^35, then optionally require membership in the 26-glyph codebook.
binary_weighted_sum.serialization: Store decimal strings or arbitrary-precision integers. Although the present 35-bit bound fits JavaScript's exact integer range, use BigInt in implementations so a later dimension increase does not silently round.
binary_weighted_sum.prerequisite: All vector entries must be binary. Reject entries outside {0,1}.

bounded_count_generalization.formula: If each entry is an integer 0 <= v[i] <= M, freeze b=M+1 and encode N=sum(v[i]*b^i).
bounded_count_generalization.exact_decode: Repeated integer division by b: v[i]=N mod b; N=floor(N/b). After d digits require N=0.
bounded_count_generalization.warning: Do not keep base2 if counts may exceed1; carries would create collisions. Base, dimensions, and feature order are part of the schema version.

integer_encoding.cipher_boundary: This is an exact geometric identifier/codebook, not encryption. Numerical arithmetic on these identifiers would be a separate hypothesis, and depends on the arbitrary but frozen feature order.

limitations: The modeled glyphs are not measurements of Kryptos lettering or historical handwriting.
Changing fonts, bars, serifs, curve conventions, or geometry can change the vectors.
Unique arrays establish a representation only. They do not establish encryption, a key, plaintext, or creator intent.
Primitive order is intentionally ignored. Any ordered stroke-sequence hypothesis requires a separate schema.
A few coarse line/curve totals may collide even when the full geometry vectors do not.
